title: Preparing the café’s coffee tasting
titleZh: 準備咖啡店的試飲活動
passage:
F: For this morning’s tasting, put the coffee cups on the counter without the roast names. We'll tell people what they tried after they've made their notes.
M: Should I give them the card with the pictures of the beans before they sit down?
F: Yes. It only shows how the beans look at each stage of roasting. Keep the card that lists the roast names behind the counter.
M: One guest called to ask for decaf. Do we have anything for her?
F: Yes. Let her know which cup is decaf before serving her. For the rest, set out water so they can rinse between tastes.
passageZh:
F: 今天早上的試飲，先把咖啡杯放在櫃檯，不要標出烘焙品項。等大家記完心得，再告訴他們喝了哪一款。
M: 客人坐下前，我要先把有咖啡豆圖片的那張卡給他們嗎？
F: 要。那張卡只呈現咖啡豆在各個烘焙階段的樣子。把列有烘焙品項名稱的那張卡留在櫃檯後面。
M: 有位客人打電話來問有沒有低咖啡因咖啡。我們有準備嗎？
F: 有。端給她之前，先告訴她哪一杯是低咖啡因的。其他客人就準備一些水，讓他們在每次試飲之間漱口。
